name: Campobasso (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, navy blue above and red below.
history: Municipal flag of Campobasso, a comune in Molise; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 25 May 1942.
